rationale: Fixes the -$9,500 cash deficit by extending land expansion to 28-30 plots through Day 16 while strictly capping the workforce at 9 hands, guaranteeing 1 engine order always remains available for critical market liquidations and seed procurement. It reinstates the 2-cycle Carrot liquidity engine (Days 1-4) to build $1,500+ capital before the Strawberry transition, reclaims Town Shop margins via 3-4 flexible contract plots, and deploys a Day 23-26 rapid Carrot cash-out on barren acreage, while crucially retaining in-situ harvest-and-water micro-dispatch to prevent Strawberry regrowth freezing (the fatal flaw of Gens 85-87).
